classes.name: ChannelPostsTransformer
classes.description: Transforms channel post models to a structured format, providing access to specific fields and actions like delete and link generation.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value of a specified key from the model, handling 'id' by returning 'post_id'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the post ID from the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Provides available actions for the post, such as delete, with URL endpoints.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates a URL link to the post, depending on the type and key provided.
